verdict.rationale: Lithic publishes extensive first-party API reference docs (cards, disputes, events, auth rules, ASA, versioning, KYC) and an official MCP server letting AI agents search docs, inspect schemas, and execute live API calls directly from editors, directly matching the AI-native 'documented public API' story. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard paths) and independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
